visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens at night on an urban street. A man and a young boy with curly hair are walking towards a food stall. A bright orange sign with text is prominent in the background, and a shop called '白滷豆干' (White Braised Dried Tofu) is visible with its lights on. (2) Close-up on a wooden cutting board where a pair of hands is using a traditional Chinese cleaver to slice thick, square pieces of brown braised dried tofu into remarkably thin strips. The lighting is bright and localized over the food preparation area. (3) The slices are placed into a white cardboard takeaway container. A large amount of chopped green scallions is added on top, almost burying the tofu. A hand then squeezes a dark brown sauce from a plastic bottle onto the pile of scallions and tofu. (4) Close-up shot of the young boy standing on the street, looking curiously towards the food stall. He is wearing a dark jacket. (5) A static shot of the shop's menu board displays various braised items and their prices, decorated with traditional Chinese motifs. (6) The camera shifts to an indoor setting, likely a bedroom, where a man in a black tank top is eating the braised tofu using green chopsticks. He looks directly at the camera with a satisfied and slightly exaggerated expression, eventually closing his eyes in enjoyment. The lighting is warm and domestic.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: 上年貨偵查部. [Subtitle]: 前一陣子 無意間發現. (2) [Subtitle]: 東寧路老四川隔壁 有一家白滷的小店. (3) [Subtitle]: 他主要賣的是 白滷的豆乾. (4) [Subtitle]: 重點是老闆切豆乾 切得非常的薄 這點非常的加分. (5) [Subtitle]: 而且他的蔥 彷彿才是主菜一樣 倒得比豆乾還多. (6) [Subtitle]: 第一次來買 我買了兩份豆乾. (7) [Subtitle]: 老闆對我說 一份豆乾的量 就很多了. (8) [Subtitle]: 所以我傻傻的 只買了一份. (9) [Subtitle]: 誰知道 回家吃完以後 才知道後悔. (10) [Subtitle]: 所以這一次 我一次買四份 吃到吐 我也爽. (11) [Subtitle]: 他們的價格在這裡 俗到脫褲子. (12) [Subtitle]: 雖然我要脫的時候 被老闆娘拒絕 差點報警. (13) [Subtitle]: 不過看這切這麼薄 又是白滷 不死鹹的豆乾. (14) [Subtitle]: 就算是真被警察抓走 還是很值得 為他脫褲子. (15) [Subtitle]: 店家地址：台南市東區東學路536號.
